title: Star Clicker
description: Tap the giant star to collect stardust, then spend it on gloves, comets, rockets and whole galaxies that collect stars for you. A cheerful idle clicker game that keeps going even while you take a break.
instructions: Click or tap the big star to collect stars (or press Space).
Buy upgrades on the right to earn more per click or per second.
Press keys 1–6 to buy upgrades quickly.
Your progress saves automatically in this browser.
